Maya: PR #15999 is green locally and ready for merge, but needs 2 approvals. I'm blocked by CI queue and want to land before the weekend blackout (Sat 00:00 UTC). Can someone give review + help rerun flaky CI?
Kevin: I can take a quick look now. Which tests are failing on CI?
Maya: CI shows a flaky unit on mac-e2e and one failing assertion in encoding tests. snapshot pasted below.
Maya: ```
FAIL: test_delta_decode (__main__.TestEncode)
AssertionError: expected 42 got 41
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/test_encode.py", line 88, in test_delta_decode
    self.assertEqual(decoded, 42)
```
Kevin: hmmm looks like a nondeterministic seed in that test. I can push a tiny test fix but prefer rerun first to confirm.
ci-bot: Pipeline queued (#15999) — mac-e2e: queued, linux-unit: passed, integration: running.
Rebecca: Heads up - we have a deploy blackout window starting Sat 00:00 UTC for infra maintenance. If this needs special handling, we should either land before 23:30 UTC Friday or plan a canary Monday.
Sanjay: I can grab the rebase and push the branch with the test skip + note, if you want to avoid the rebase slot dance. How urgent is landing?
Maya: Prefer before blackout if possible. If CI rerun passes I'll ask for approvals and merge. If it flakily fails again, happy for Sanjay to rebase and push fix.
Kevin: Ok I'll /rerun the mac-e2e job now. @Rebecca if it passes can you give one approval? I'm +1 for the code change after a quick glance.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered by Kevin — mac-e2e job restarting (job id: 98765).
ci-bot: mac-e2e: flaky failure reproduced on first run, rerun result: PASSED.
Maya: Great — thanks. Adding @Rebecca for approval.
Rebecca: Reviewing now, skimmed diff, seems fine. Leaving an inline nit but not blocking. Approving. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: +1 from me as well.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll hold merge until 23:15 UTC to give time for any late issues, otherwise will merge and queue canary.
Sanjay: If anything goes sideways during the 15 min hold ping me and I'll revert.
Maya: Merge done at 1749933890. Canaries scheduled. Logging this for post-mortem if the encoding test regresses again. :seedling:
ci-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for canary. Monitoring started.
